correctness.rationale: For n>=2 independent uniform points on a circle and 0<s<=1/3, overlap of circular arcs has Y_ij=(s-D_ij)_+. Deterministic expansion gives V_n=ns-n²s²+2 sum_{i<j}Y_ij. Center h_ij=Y_ij-s² is conditionally mean zero in either endpoint. In E(sum h)^3, any three-edge multigraph having a vertex of degree1 vanishes, leaving a triply repeated edge (binomial(n,2) choices) and a triangle (6 binomial(n,3) ordered choices). E[h^3]=s⁴/2-2s⁵+2s⁶; for triangle, integrate quadrant products at s<=1/3: equal-sign contribution 11/30*s⁵ and opposite-sign 11/60*s⁵, totaling 11/20*s⁵; centered triangle E=11/20*s⁵-s⁶. Independent SymPy exact double integrals reproduced 11/30,11/60,11/20; direct algebra with multiplicities gives κ3=2n(n-1)s⁴[(1-2s)²+(n-2)(11s/5-4s²)]. Pair orthogonality gives κ2=(4/3)n(n-1)s³(1-3s/2). The bracket is positive on 0<s<=1/3, and asymptotic substitution yields stated ns->0,τ,∞ constants without asserting a CLT. The s<=1/3 condition excludes positive-measure triple winding, and n=2 removes triangle terms.
residual_risks: The exact third moment is not a central limit theorem; skewness can fail to vanish if n²s stays bounded. Triple-winding configuration at s>1/3 is outside scope.
